source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by flat white RGB 253)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, pixels of the original 1080x1920 frame; t = frame/30

camera.note: flat white background, no texture; ground line (lowest hoof/paw pixel) constant at y=1549-1553 for both animals in all frames, apparent sizes constant -> no zoom, no pan detectable; motion is in a plane facing the camera.

ibex.description: large brown ibex/antelope-like quadruped with long swept-back ridged horn(s), whitish snout, long tufted tail; walks left->right (faces right)
ibex.occluded: never; never touches the frame edge (snout x1=1042 at f74)
ibex.reference_point_recommended: cx_centroid, cy_centroid (whole-mask centroid, close to the body/hip root); trunk_cx = centre of torso barrel (rows 1300-1400) as alternative

rabbit.description: small brown rabbit/hare-like animal on the ground just ahead (right) of the ibex front hooves; moves right with it at nearly the same speed, small hop-like body bob (height 52-72 px)
rabbit.occluded: never by the ibex; partly cut by the right image edge from frame 69 on (touches_edge=1; f74 only 32 px of it visible) -> centroid/bbox centre biased left in 69-74; use x0 (rear edge) + ~half median length there

background_ground.description: no visible floor or scenery (segmented): only an implied ground line at y~1551 where hooves/paws rest

events.event: both animals already moving right at start (no start-from-rest)
rabbit front reaches right image edge (x=1079)

events.note: ibex gait: centroid dx per frame oscillates ~5.5-8 px with the walk cycle (irregular ~20-frame rhythm, peaks near f9-11, 23, 29-30, 49-51, 69-74); no direction change; vertical centroid bob only +-3.5 px. Rabbit dx per frame 3-10 px in hop cycles (period ~12-13 frames, faster phases near f7, 19-20, 32-33, 45-46, 58-59), no direction change.
